rationale: The agent executed order-changing writes (exchanges and returns) via tool calls without any visible customer confirmation, violating the policy requirement to confirm before acting. While the agent looked up the user by name and ZIP (basic authentication) and operated on what appear to be the user’s orders, there is no evidence of confirmation of the specific items or payment method before initiating the exchanges/returns. Additionally, the conversation provides no clear mapping of item IDs to the user’s requested items (two skateboards, smart watch, e-reader), making it unclear whether all requested items were handled correctly. The final message is a generic closure without details of outcomes, further suggesting incomplete adherence to the policy. Thus, the interaction fails the pass bar.
